title: Théorie arithmétique. Théorie de Galois des motifs (1965) : notes manuscites (s.d.), tapuscrit (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not about motives. It is a typed erratum sheet for SGA 3, Exposé VIII, §7, which treats the question of when a monomorphism of group schemes is an immersion. It has handwritten corrections, a blue-ink addition 'On peut montrer que', and a handwritten note 'Page 35, ligne 9,10, supprimer "lisse sur k"'. It has evidently been misfiled among the 'Théorie de Galois des motifs' notes; the neighbouring pages are about Tannakian/motivic Galois groups over R.

Content of the replacement Remarques 7.10:
- Setting (theorem 7.9 c). We have a monomorphism u: G → H of S-group schemes of finite presentation. One assumes the p^ν-torsion subgroups _{p^ν}G' are finite over S' and the _{p^ν}H' are separated over S', and concludes that u is an immersion.
- (a) If G has connected fibres, separatedness of _{p^ν}H' can be dropped. After the reductions made in the proof one may take u bijective. Then H has connected fibres, so H is separated by Raynaud's separation theorem (SGA 3 Exp. VI_B).
- (b) Examples of Raynaud show that, in general, neither the finiteness hypothesis on _{p^ν}G' nor the separatedness hypothesis on _{p^ν}H' can be dropped.
- (c) The conclusion of (a) also holds if G is of multiplicative type instead of having connected fibres. That is, every monomorphism u: G → H of finitely presented S-group schemes with G of multiplicative type is an immersion. Grothendieck downgraded this from an outright assertion ('La conclusion…') to 'On peut montrer que…'.
- Further lines correct 'S' to S'' on line 14 and delete 'lisse sur k' on page 35.

This is the familiar statement of SGA 3 (VIII 7.10 / IX 2.5-type results): a monomorphism from a group of multiplicative type into a finitely presented group is an immersion.
errors: No mathematical errors detected. Statement (c) is asserted without proof ('On peut montrer'); it is a known result established in SGA 3 (Exp. IX, results around 2.5, building on Exp. VIII §7).
The page is misfiled: it belongs to the SGA 3 typescript/errata, not to the 'Galois theory of motives' notes surrounding it.

ideas.what: Monomorphism of finitely presented group schemes with source connected-fibred is an immersion, using Raynaud's separation theorem
ideas.modern_name: Monomorphisms of group schemes are immersions (under hypotheses); Raynaud's separatedness criterion for group schemes with connected fibres

ideas.modern_name: Monomorphisms from multiplicative-type groups are immersions

deep.surprise_reason: This is an errata sheet for SGA 3 Exp. VIII whose content was incorporated into the published SGA 3. Its only interest is archival: it is misfiled among the motivic Galois notes.
transcription_corrections: The struck text after 'multiplicatif;' is probably 'i.e.' or 'c.à.d.', replaced by the handwritten continuation; the sentence reads 'multiplicatif; i.e. tout monomorphisme…'.

In 'avec G de type multiplicatif, [-...-]H est une immersion', the struck fragment probably replaced 'u: G→' or similar. The intended reading is 'avec G de type multiplicatif, est une immersion' (referring to u).
'groupes, de présentation finie': a typed comma/asterisk mark appears after 'groupes'.
The handwritten final line reads 'Page 35, ligne 9,10, supprimer "lisse sur k".' The transcription is correct.
In 'Exp VI_B', a blank space for a precise reference number (marked with x) is left unfilled; likewise a blank after 'exemples de Raynaud'.
